review: Reviewed the retained round-70 pause: the pre-inference guard refused Ivo's next ordinary decision because the complete request was estimated at 14,396 o200k tokens against the frozen inputEstimateLimit of 14,000 (packet 9,848: observation 2,648, memory 2,409, abilities 2,146, execution 1,340; retained retrieval of two query batches 1,968; instructions 859). The other five people measured 8,721-10,272. A culture-gated, lossless and disclosed compaction of the ordinary packet (settled work records summarized with exact-query access, duplicate catalogue entries and page notes removed, contiguous parts joined) was implemented and measured at 12,674 for Ivo with ex7-ex14 compatibility digests identical, but every packet change lives in apps/simulator/src/long-context.ts, which the source verifier protects mid-run ('require a separate run version'). Changes limited to unprotected modules (query index, catalogue view, capability view) save at most about 125 tokens without dropping Ivo's retained retrieval, which would be hidden truncation because no query batch remains this round. No permitted change resolves the guard, and changing the verifier policy or starting a new run version is outside this run's authorization. This recovery therefore installs no package, changes no source, budget or policy, and is submitted only to close the counted attempt: the run is expected to pause again at the same guard before any model call, so the paused state can be captured and archived. Continuing ex15 requires a user decision.
